process.reason: Helps chunk generation keep up while background apps run. Restored when the game exits.

graphicsGuidance.title: Render / simulation distance
graphicsGuidance.detail: The biggest performance lever in Java Edition; 12–16 chunks is a good balance.

graphicsGuidance.title: Memory allocation (Java)
graphicsGuidance.detail: In the launcher's JVM arguments, 4–6 GB (-Xmx4G … -Xmx6G) is enough for vanilla; more can increase garbage-collection pauses.

graphicsGuidance.title: Performance mods (Java)
graphicsGuidance.detail: Optimisation mods such as Sodium (Fabric) greatly improve frame rates; install them only from their official sources.
